text: FAA guidance says to reestablish a control link if lost and, if unrecoverable, initiate emergency procedures or discontinue flight. It also requires the remote PIC to change routing/altitude or command a landing during automated flight, and AC 107-2A states commands may include climb, descend, land now, or return to home. The DJI Matrice 210 V1 manual claims Failsafe RTH auto-activates after a lost controller signal >3 seconds and the aircraft retraces its original route home. There is no usable evidence from incident reports cited for the Matrice 210 V1; they are unverified accounts.
